_readme: Example only. APF does not read this file; copy it to plugin_profiles.json (or generate one with learn_profile.py).
match: lowercase substrings looked for in the VST2 and VST3 plugin names.
fill_controller_state: copy the preset state into ControllerState (do this if Live's own VST3 save has both filled).
state_format 'cm-sections': the state is text ('#cm=Section' then 'Key=Value' lines) from which real parameter values are read.
parameters: keyed by parameter id (assumed identical in the VST2 and VST3). min/max: the VST3 real-unit range;
section/key: where the value lives in the state text (optional; without them the 0-1 value is rescaled linearly);
stepped: round to a whole number.
blank_unmapped: configured slots whose id is not listed become blank slots instead of staying clamped at their minimum.
verified: false prints a warning whenever the profile is used.
